decision.summary: A confirmed temporary offset in U (and coupled E) occurs from index 608 to 612: sharp drop in U (~3 MAD), coincident small opposing dip in E, neutral N, and full recovery by 612. The platform noted until 615 is not part of the offset interval because U stabilizes at baseline by 612 and no opposing return edge is observed after 612—thus the post-612 plateau is either noise or unrelated slow motion. No other temporary offsets are confirmed within allowed_context [570,650].

intervals.observation: U-component shows abrupt drop (~3 MAD) starting at index 608, reaching minimum near 609–610; E-component exhibits smaller opposing dip (negative) concurrent with U-drop; N remains neutral. U recovers sharply by index 612 to near pre-event level, with no sustained offset beyond. Cross-axis coupling and rapid return support a transient vertical offset.
